2025

2025-01-09 - MEADOWLANDS ARENA, EAST RUTHERFORD, NJ

Bruce once again visits the set of his biopic Deliver Me From Nowhere, this time with Jon Landau and Brian J. Monaco. Most likely the filming of the 1981 tour performance took more than just one day, with Bruce visiting more than once.


2025-01-10 - INTERSECTION OF MAIN AND SOUTH, FREEHOLD, NJ

Bruce visits the set of his biopic Deliver Me From Nowhere in the town where he grew up. He meets actor Jeremy Allen White and Matthew Anthony Pellicano. After the visit, Bruce and some people from the film crew went to Federici's.


2025-01-18 - HACKENSACK MERIDIAN HEALTH THEATRE, RED BANK, NJ

Soundcheck (with Joe Grushecky & The Houserockers): DARKNESS ON THE EDGE OF TOWN / THE PROMISED LAND / SAVIN' UP

with Jesse Malin: BROKEN RADIO

with Willie Nile: ONE GUITAR (with James Maddock)

with Joe Grushecky & The Houserockers: NEVER BE ENOUGH TIME / DARKNESS ON THE EDGE OF TOWN / THE PROMISED LAND / SAVIN' UP / PUMPING IRON (with Danny Clinch) / PINK CADILLAC (with Danny Clinch) / LIGHT OF DAY - HAPPY BIRTHDAY TO YOU (with all performers) / THUNDER ROAD (with all performers)

Bruce makes a surprise appearance at the twenty-fifth anniversary edition of the Light Of Day Benefit, playing a song each with Jesse Malin and Willie Nile and a full set backed by Joe Grushecky & The Houserockers, plus Jeff Kazee on keys. Grushecky's guitar solo replaces the saxophone during "The Promised Land". Most of the evening's performers and the event's organizers are onstage for the finale, "Light Of Day" and the sing-along "Thunder Road".


2025-01-00 - SPRINGSTEEN RESIDENCE, COLTS NECK, NJ

Bruce Springsteen is joined at his home by a BBC production team to film segments for a new documentary titled When Bruce Springsteen Came To Britain to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Springsteen's first concert in the UK. The documentary will air on BBC TV in May.


2025-03-26 - CARNEGIE HALL, NEW YORK CITY, NY

BECAUSE THE NIGHT / PEOPLE HAVE THE POWER (with all performers)

Bruce Springsteen participates in 'People Have The Power: A Celebration of Patti Smith', a benefit presented by Michael Dorf in support of music education for underserved youth. He performs "Because The Night" backed by the house band and then plays guitar and sings backup during the Patti Smith-led all-star finale, "People Have The Power". Participating artists include Paul Banks (Interpol), Courtney Barnett, Matt Berninger (The National), Body/Head (Kim Gordon & Bill Nace), Johnny Depp, Glen Hansard, Ben Harper, Susanna Hoffs, Music Will Academy Of Lower Manhattan Public Middle School, Karen O, Kronos Quartet, Jesse Malin, Alison Mosshart (The Kills), Angel Olsen, Maggie Rogers, Michael Shannon, Michael Stipe, and Sharon Van Etten, with readings by Jim Jarmusch, Scarlett Johansson, and Sean Penn.


2025-04-22 - HACKENSACK MERIDIAN HEALTH THEATRE, RED BANK, NJ

NEBRASKA / ATLANTIC CITY / MANSION ON THE HILL / JOHNNY 99 / HIGHWAY PATROLMAN / STATE TROOPER / USED CARS / OPEN ALL NIGHT / MY FATHER'S HOUSE / REASON TO BELIEVE

Filming (by Thom Zimny) of a live performance, sans audience, of Nebraska for the Nebraska '82: Expanded Edition box set, released October 17, 2025 including both audio and video of this event. Several takes of each song are performed by Springsteen with light backing from Larry Campbell and Charles Giordano.


2025-04-26 - SPRINGSTEEN RESIDENCE, COLTS NECK, NJ

Bruce Springsteen sat down for an in-depth interview at his Colts Neck, New Jersey home, offering reflections that coincide with a pivotal moment in his long and storied career. The interview was published in the Sunday Times magazine in June 2025.


2025-04-26 - POLLAK THEATRE, MONMOUTH UNIVERSITY, WEST LONG BRANCH, NJ

Soundcheck: THE GHOST OF TOM JOAD (with Tom Morello) / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT (with Tom Morello)

ALL JUST TO GET TO YOU / THE GHOST OF TOM JOAD (with Tom Morello) / BAD MOON RISING (with John Fogerty) / GOING TO A GO-GO (with Smokey Robinson and Steven Van Zandt) / TAKE IT EASY (with Jackson Browne, Tom Morello, and Nils Lofgren) / PROUD MARY (with John Fogerty and Nils Lofgren) / FORTUNATE SON (with John Fogerty) / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT (with Tom Morello and Nils Lofgren) / THIS LAND IS YOUR LAND (with Darlene Love, Nora Guthrie, Emmylou Harris, Patti Scialfa, Tom Morello, John Fogerty, Jackson Browne, Steven Van Zandt, and Nils Lofgren)

Bruce Springsteen appears at the third annual American Music Honors, a presentation of the Bruce Springsteen Archives & Center For American Music at Monmouth University. The 2025 inductees are Smokey Robinson (inducted by Steven Van Zandt), Emmylou Harris (inducted by Patti Scialfa), Tom Morello (inducted by Nils Lofgren), John Fogerty, and, in absentia, Joe Ely (the last two inducted by Springsteen himself). Brian Williams serves as the evening's host and The Disciples Of Soul act as house band; Jackson Browne and Darlene Love also make surprise appearances.


2025-04-28 - SABAN MEDIA CENTER, LOS ANGELS, CA

Bruce Springsteen, director Thom Zimny, and Max Weinberg participate in a Q&A hosted by journalist Anthony Breznican after a screening of Road Diary: Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band as part of a For Your Emmy Consideration event. Bruce, Thom, and Max sat in the theater to watch the full film prior to the Q&A.


2025-04-00 - SPRINGSTEEN RESIDENCE, COLTS NECK, NJ

Some time in spring 2025, Springsteen tapes a Fathers' Day themed episode of the podcast IMO with Michelle Obama and Craig Robinson, released on June 11, 2025. Both the recording date and the location are uncertain, but presumably took place prior to Bruce's European tour.

If you have any information (eg. setlist, memories, ticket stub or other images, as applicable) regarding this date please get in touch.


2025-05-00 - DOCK10 STUDIOS, MANCHESTER, ENGLAND

No set details known.

Bruce and members of The E Street Band are in Manchester (first seen on May 8) to rehearse for their upcoming shows in Manchester. One or more rehearsals took place at this television studio facility, before moving to the Co-op Live on May 13.

If you have any information (eg. setlist, memories, ticket stub or other images, as applicable) regarding this date please get in touch.


2025-05-13 - CO-OP LIVE, MANCHESTER, ENGLAND

No set details known.

Private rehearsals in advance of the first 2025 show. The actual songs rehearsed are uncertain, although a photograph of the printed setlist for the rehearsal is available.

If you have any information (eg. setlist, memories, ticket stub or other images, as applicable) regarding this date please get in touch.

2025-05-14 - CO-OP LIVE, MANCHESTER, ENGLAND

LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS - PEOPLE GET READY / DEATH TO MY HOMETOWN / LONESOME DAY / MY LOVE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN / RAINMAKER / DARKNESS ON THE EDGE OF TOWN / THE PROMISED LAND / HUNGRY HEART / MY HOMETOWN / YOUNGSTOWN / MURDER INCORPORATED / LONG WALK HOME / HOUSE OF A THOUSAND GUITARS / MY CITY OF RUINS / LETTER TO YOU / BECAUSE THE NIGHT / HUMAN TOUCH / WRECKING BALL / THE RISING / BADLANDS / THUNDER ROAD / BORN IN THE U.S.A. / BORN TO RUN / BOBBY JEAN / DANCING IN THE DARK / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / CHIMES OF FREEDOM

The 2025 'Land Of Hope And Dreams Tour' kicks off with a 27-song song set including the live premiere of "Rainmaker" as well as the first "Chimes Of Freedom" since 1988 to close. "House Of A Thousand Guitars" makes its first ever performance in Europe, in a solo acoustic arrangement. "Long Walk Home" features a brief guitar snippet of "Land Of Hope And Dreams" in the intro. Final tour performance of "Letter To You". Bruce opens the show with a short speech, to be included throughout the leg: "It's great to be in Manchester and back in the UK. Welcome to the Land Of Hope And Dreams Tour. The mighty E Street Band is here tonight to call upon the righteous power of art, of music, of rock n' roll in dangerous times. In my home, the America I love, the America I have written about, that has been a beacon of hope and liberty for 250 years, is currently in the hands of a corrupt, incompetent and treasonous administration. Tonight we ask all who believe in democracy and the best of our American experiment to rise with us, raise your voices against authoritarianism, and let freedom ring. This is Land of Hope and Dreams." Curt Ramm returns to the E Street Horns lineup.


2025-05-17 - CO-OP LIVE, MANCHESTER, ENGLAND

LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS - PEOPLE GET READY / DEATH TO MY HOMETOWN / LONESOME DAY / OUT IN THE STREET / RAINMAKER / ATLANTIC CITY / THE PROMISED LAND / HUNGRY HEART / THE RIVER / YOUNGSTOWN / MURDER INCORPORATED / LONG WALK HOME / HOUSE OF A THOUSAND GUITARS / MY CITY OF RUINS / GHOSTS / BECAUSE THE NIGHT / HUMAN TOUCH / WRECKING BALL / THE RISING / BADLANDS / THUNDER ROAD / BORN IN THE U.S.A. / BORN TO RUN / BOBBY JEAN / DANCING IN THE DARK / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / CHIMES OF FREEDOM

27-song setlist for night two in Manchester includes four changes from the first show, including the first performance of "Out In The Street" since 2023, along with "Atlantic City", "The River", and "Ghosts". Dropped from night one are "My Love Will Not Let You Down", "Darkness On The Edge Of Town", "My Hometown", and "Letter To You". "Long Walk Home" includes the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" guitar intro.


2025-05-19 - EVE STUDIOS, BREDBURY, ENGLAND

HOLLOW MAN

Setlist may be inaccurate.

Bruce booked studio time at Eve Studios on this date, according to the article in the Manchester Evening News. However, photos were posted by the studio to Instagram on May 15, and reports on Facebook suggest that this actually took place on Monday May 12. It is not known what Bruce recorded at this session; however, around this time, he did record his contribution to Bon Jovi's re-recording of "Hollow Man", released as a single on August 29, 2025, and on their album Forever (Legendary Edition) on October 17, 2025. We have placed that recording here for convenience; this is, however, entirely speculative.

If you have any information (eg. setlist, memories, ticket stub or other images, as applicable) regarding this date please get in touch.

30-song set, with "Ghosts" opening the show for the first time. Paul McCartney joins Bruce and the band in his hometown for the sole tour performances of "Can't Buy Me Love" (Bruce's first performance of the song) and "Kansas City" (in its first ever Springsteen performance in Europe). "Seeds" also has its final tour performance. "Long Walk Home" includes the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" intro snippet, while "Twist And Shout" features a brief "La Bamba".

32-song setlist for night two is interrupted midway by thunderstorms, with the show pausing after the first verse of "House Of A Thousand Guitars" for about twenty minutes before being resumed with a solo electric version of "Growin' Up". That song, as well as "Prove It All Night", "Darlington County", "Working On The Highway", and "I'm On Fire", makes its first appearance of 2025, while "My City Of Ruins" is dropped for the first time on the Land Of Hope And Dreams Tour. "Long Walk Home" includes the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" guitar intro and "Twist And Shout" features a snippet of "Bad Girls" in the midsection. Final tour performances for "Growin' Up", "Darlington County", "Working On The Highway", and "Glory Days". Steven Van Zandt is absent from the show recovering from emergency appendicitis surgery.

2025-06-30 - STADIO GIUSEPPE MEAZZA, MILAN, ITALY

Soundcheck: NO SURRENDER / MY LOVE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN / HOUSE OF A THOUSAND GUITARS / DARKNESS ON THE EDGE OF TOWN / THE PROMISED LAND / PROVE IT ALL NIGHT

NO SURRENDER / MY LOVE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN / LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS - PEOPLE GET READY / DEATH TO MY HOMETOWN / LONESOME DAY / RAINMAKER / ATLANTIC CITY / THE PROMISED LAND / HUNGRY HEART / THE RIVER / YOUNGSTOWN / MURDER INCORPORATED / LONG WALK HOME / HOUSE OF A THOUSAND GUITARS / MY CITY OF RUINS / I'M ON FIRE / BECAUSE THE NIGHT / WRECKING BALL / THE RISING / BADLANDS / THUNDER ROAD / BORN IN THE U.S.A. / BORN TO RUN / BOBBY JEAN / DANCING IN THE DARK / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / TWIST AND SHOUT / CHIMES OF FREEDOM

28-song setlist, almost identical to the previous show in Gelsenkirchen but with "Atlantic City" replacing "Darkness On The Edge Of Town". "Long Walk Home" includes the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" guitar intro. First ever performances in Italy for "Rainmaker" and "House Of A Thousand Guitars", and final tour performances for "No Surrender", "Lonesome Day", "Atlantic City", and "I'm On Fire". Steven Van Zandt returns to the stage after recovering from emergency appendicitis surgery. Southside Johnny is at the show as well, but does not perform. Show rescheduled from June 1, 2024.


2025-07-03 - STADIO GIUSEPPE MEAZZA, MILAN, ITALY

MY LOVE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN / PROVE IT ALL NIGHT / DARKNESS ON THE EDGE OF TOWN / LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS - PEOPLE GET READY / DEATH TO MY HOMETOWN / RAINMAKER / THE PROMISED LAND / HUNGRY HEART / MY HOMETOWN / THE RIVER / YOUNGSTOWN / MURDER INCORPORATED / LONG WALK HOME / HOUSE OF A THOUSAND GUITARS / MY CITY OF RUINS / BECAUSE THE NIGHT / WRECKING BALL / THE RISING / BADLANDS / THUNDER ROAD / BORN IN THE U.S.A. / BORN TO RUN / BOBBY JEAN / DANCING IN THE DARK / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / TWIST AND SHOUT / CHIMES OF FREEDOM / ROCKIN' ALL OVER THE WORLD

28-song setlist for the tour finale ending with the year's first "Rockin' All Over The World". Italian fans in the seats organized a large flag display that reads "See Me In Your Dreams", which greets the band when they arrive on stage. "Long Walk Home" includes the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" guitar intro. "Twist And Shout" features a snippet of "Bad Girls" in the midsection. With their performances at this show, "The Promised Land", "Because The Night", "Wrecking Ball", "The Rising", "Badlands", "Born To Run", "Dancing In The Dark", and "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out" were played at every show of the 2023–25 International Tour; in addition to those songs, "Land Of Hope And Dreams", "Death To My Hometown", "Rainmaker", "Youngstown", "Murder Incorporated", "Long Walk Home", "House Of A Thousand Guitars" (at least in part), "Thunder Road", "Born In The U.S.A.", and "Chimes Of Freedom" were played at every show of the 2025 Land Of Hope And Dreams Tour. Show rescheduled from June 3, 2024.

End of the of the "Land Of Hope And Dreams" tour

End of the "2023-25 International" tour


2025-07-20 - METLIFE STADIUM, EAST RUTHERFORD, NJ

ATLANTIC CITY (with Caleb Followill) / REVIVAL

Bruce Springsteen makes a guest appearance at Zach Bryan's show, introduced as "one of the greatest men to ever exist." Bruce performs "Atlantic City" with Bryan and Caleb Followill, and also joins on the show's encore "Revival". Springsteen's "House Of A Thousand Guitars" was played from tape before the show started.


2025-08-29 - THE WERNER HERZOG THEATRE, TOWN PARK PAVILLION, TELLURIDE, CO

Bruce and Patti attend the Telluride Film Festival for the world premiere of the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere.


2025-08-30 - PALM THEATER, TELLURIDE, CO

After the second-ever screening of Deliver Me From Nowhere at the Telluride Film Festival, Bruce takes part in a Q&A alongside Jon Landau and the film's director and stars. "I'm old and I don't give a f*ck what I do," Bruce explained when asked why he agreed to have his life depicted on screen for the first time!


2025-09-06 - POLLAK THEATRE, MONMOUTH UNIVERSITY, WEST LONG BRANCH, NJ

THUNDER ROAD / BORN TO RUN

Bruce attends the Bruce Springsteen Archives & Center for American Music's 50th Anniversary Symposium for Born To Run. He participates in a few Q&A panels and closes the symposium by performing both "Born To Run" and "Thunder Road" with past and present members of The E Street Band.


2025-09-28 - ALICE TULLY HALL, LINCOLN CENTER, NEW YORK CITY, NY

LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS

Springsteen attends the premiere of the biopic Deliver Me From Nowhere as part of the New York Film Festival. After the film's screening, Bruce gives a brief speech and performs a solo acoustic "Land Of Hope And Dreams". Jon Landau, the film's director Scott Cooper, and its stars Jeremy Allen White and Odessa Young also attend.


2025-10-02 SIRIUSXUM STUDIO, NEW YORK CITY, NY

Jim Rotolo interviews Springsteen and Jeremy Allen White in a SiriusXM 'Town Hall' event to promote Deliver Me From Nowhere. A small studio audience is selected by ticket giveaway.


2025-10-02 - HOWARD GILMAN OPERA HOUSE, BROOKLYN, NY

Bruce and Jeremy Allen White appear on Jimmy Kimmel Live! during its 'Brooklyn week' to promote Deliver Me From Nowhere.


2025-10-14 - SPOTIFY HQ, THE ADELPHI, LONDON, ENGLAND

Bruce, together with Jeremy Allen White, participates in a Q&A session organized by Spotify to promote the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere.


2025-10-15 - ROYAL FESTIVAL HALL, SOUTHBANK CENTRE, LONDON, ENGLAND

Bruce attends the film premiere of the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere at the 69th BFI London Film Festival, and participates in a Q&A session together with Jon Landau, Scott Cooper, Jeremy Allen White, Jeremy Strong, Odessa Young, and Stephen Graham. Bruce and White also sit down for an interview with Fabio Fazio to be broadcast at the Italian television show Che Tempo Che Fa on October 19.


2025-10-16 - CLARIDGE'S, LONDON, ENGLAND

Bruce Springsteen and Jeremy Allen White join Scott Mills for an exclusive interview to talk about the new biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere. The Scott Mills Breakfast Show broadcasts the interview on BBC Radio 2 on October 22.


2025-10-16 - TELEVISION CENTRE, STUDIO 1, LONDON, ENGLAND

Bruce Springsteen appears on The Graham Norton Show to talk about the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere. The show is broadcast on October 18. In Norton's standard format, Bruce is interviewed simultaneously alongside the other guests, Jennifer Lawrence, Tessa Thompson, and Jeremy Allen White. Florence + The Machine is the musical guest, performing "Everybody Scream" from their upcoming album Everybody Scream.


2025-10-18 - DAVID GEFFEN THEATER, ACADEMY MUSEUM OF MOTION PICTURES, LOS ANGELES, CA

STREETS OF PHILADELPHIA / ATLANTIC CITY / LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS

Bruce and Patti Scialfa attend the fifth Annual Gala Academy Museum Gala, presented by The Academy Museum of Motion Pictures. Springsteen received the Legacy Award and he performed solo acoustic versions of "Streets Of Philadelphia" (played for only the tenth time in the last 25 years), "Atlantic City" and "Land Of Hope And Dreams" following his acceptance of the inaugural award. Other honorees are Penélope Cruz, Walter Salles, and Bowen Yang.


2025-10-20 - THE STONE PONY, ASBURY PARK, NJ

Bruce Springsteen and some Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere cast members give a behind-the-scenes in an ABC interview about the making of the film. The interview was broadcast on Good Morning America on this date, but it was pre-recorded on an unknown date earlier in the fall.

If you have any information (eg. setlist, memories, ticket stub or other images, as applicable) regarding this date please get in touch.


2025-10-21 - THE AMC CENTURY CITY 15, LOS ANGELES, CA

Bruce Springsteen speaks onstage during the IMAX Special Screening and Q&A in support of the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere.


2025-10-22 - TCL CHINESE THEATRE, LOS ANGELES, CA

ATLANTIC CITY / LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS

Bruce Springsteen attends the AFI Fest 2025 in support of the biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere and shares the red carpet with Patti Scialfa, Jon Landau, Jeremy Allen White, Jeremy Strong, Matthew Anthony Pellicano, and director Scott Cooper. After the screening of the film Bruce performed two songs: "Atlantic City" and "Land Of Hope And Dreams".

NEBRASKA '82: EXPANDED EDITION (October 24)


2025-10-26 - THE STONE PONY, ASBURY PARK, NJ

I DON'T WANT TO GO HOME / RAISE YOUR HAND / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT

Bruce makes a surprise appearance at Little Steven's Birthday Party At The Pony, a benefit for TeachRock presented by Hard Rock. Bruce joins Steven Van Zandt and The Disciples Of Soul for a three song set. Also performing (backed by the Disciples) during the evening are Jesse Malin, Darlene Love, and Gary U.S. Bonds. Expanded E Street Band members Curtis King Jr., Ozzie Melendez, and Barry Danielian join regular members Anthony Almonte and Ed Manion in the evening's Disciples Of Soul lineup. Jake Clemons and Michelle Moore are on hand for emcee duties; Jake also jumps onstage to sing Clarence's part during "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out".


2025-11-03 - NEW YORK PUBLIC LIBRARY, NEW YORK CITY, NY

THUNDER ROAD

Bruce Springsteen was among six honorees at the New York Public Library's annual "Library Lions" gala, which pays tribute to "outstanding achievements" in arts, culture, letters, and scholarship. Held in the grand auspices of the main research room of the 5th Avenue branch in Manhattan, the ceremony was brief, with no acceptance speeches.


2025-11-21 - THE ROY AND NIUTA TITUS THEATER 1, MUSEUM OF MODERN ART, NEW YORK CITY, NY

Bruce Springsteen attended a special screening of his biopic Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere, followed by a conversation with Scott Cooper and Jon Landau.


2025-11-21 - THE CELESTE BARTOS THEATER, MUSEUM OF MODERN ART, NEW YORK CITY, NY

Bruce, Scott Cooper, and Jon Landau participate in a second conversation following a distinct special screening of Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere, this one for a private industry audience and moderated by Jon Stewart.


2025-12-14 - THE STONE PONY, ASBURY PARK, NJ

I DON'T WANT TO GO HOME / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / MERRY CHRISTMAS BABY / SANTA CLAUS IS COMIN' TO TOWN

Springsteen joins Little Steven & The Disciples Of Soul on stage to close out the Hungerthon Benefit Concert, celebrating fifty years of the Harry Chapin-founded organization WhyHunger. Shortly after they launched into "I Don't Want To Go Home", a fire alarm went off. The lights came on, and the amplified music stopped. Although there was a lot of surprise onstage, as no one really knew what to do, the audience began a singalong of various songs, with band members gradually starting to jam along to the beat of the alarm; after observing what was happening, Bruce joined Anthony Almonte in drumming along on the congas while crowd sang "Having A Party". After five or so minutes, the alarm was turned off, the stage amplification was turned back on, and the band started over with "I Don't Want To Go Home", with Bruce and Stevie sharing the vocals. After Steve sang the line "I know it's time to go, but I don't want to go home," Bruce replied, "I don't care if that fucking fire alarm goes off!" They continued, after a false start, with a short rendition of "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out". The show closed with "Merry Christmas Baby" and "Santa Claus Is Comin' To Town". The evening's other performers include Garry Tallent, Sameer Gadhia & Eric Cannata from Young The Giant, Yola, Amy Helm, Jim Babjak and Dennis Diken of The Smithereens, Dixie Dregs, Jimmy Vivino with Mark Barden, and Steve Chapin & The Original Harry Chapin Band featuring Tom Chapin & Jen Chapin, Randy C. Moore, and an appearance by Danny Clinch.
